description:
The Club hosted an inspiring and vibrant Pinkathon event dedicated to promoting women's health awareness and encouraging a healthier lifestyle. The morning kicked off bright and early from 5:00 AM onwards, in presence of dedicated Rotarians, culminating in a grand inauguration by Club Pres, Rtn. Pprakash Kamthe, who proudly flagged off the walk/run for over 100 enthusiastic participants.
The crowd initially warmedup with an energetic and lively Zumba session led by a professional instructor, filling the atmosphere with excitement. Participants then took part in the 3 KM and 5 KM walks and runs, successfully crossing the finish line to receive well-deserved medals. Serving as the official Food Partner for the occasion, the Club provided delicious refreshments to roughly 150 participants and guests. The event concluded on a breathtaking, high note with Mallakhamb performance, students, especially the girls, showcased astonishing strength, balance, and talent, leaving everyone awestruck.
